The green light is on, so it's not off, C false.

The water tank: the transparent part on the right looks empty, you can see through it. So B false.

Thus D is correct.

Let me look really carefully at the stream. The spout is the black part on the left front of the machine. Below it, there's the cup. I see a thin brown line from the spout to the cup's liquid surface. Yes, that's an active stream.

Hence D.
